sentence: Never drag your larpet across someone else's restaurarpet.

wombos.definition: The carpet inside a restaurant — specifically invoked in the context of a messy or chaotic scene unfolding on it.
wombos.example: Don't spill that on the restaurarpet — they just cleaned it.

wombos.definition: The metaphorical carpet of someone who is deep in a larp — the performative stage or platform they stand on while pretending to be something they're not.
wombos.example: Get off your larpet — nobody actually believes you went to Harvard.
